prompt: Improve this description by replacing vague praise with concrete details already present: 'The workshop was amazing. There were six benches, tools hung where everyone could reach them, and scrap wood sorted into bins. It was a really great place to learn.' A response of around 120 words is enough.
text: The workshop had six benches, with tools hung at accessible heights so everyone could reach them without interrupting others. Scrap wood was sorted into clearly labeled bins, making it easy to find suitable pieces and keep the workspace organized. These practical details created a setting where learners could focus on their projects, share the space comfortably, and work independently. Instead of relying on general praise, the workshop’s thoughtful layout showed how it supported learning: materials were easy to locate, tools were available to everyone, and the benches provided dedicated areas for hands-on practice.
